$comment: Engine module manifest. Each top-level directory under engine/src is one bounded module.
dependsOn is the complete list of other modules a module's non-test files may import; scripts/check-engine-boundaries.mjs refuses anything else and refuses declared edges nothing uses.

cycles pins the strongly connected sets of the declared graph. They are known layering debt (the posting kernel orchestrates subledgers that post back through it) and may only shrink: a change that would grow one is refused.
Tests and engine/src/testing are composition and may import any module.
